label: s32+ats-v1
notes: Company-only Arena miner (output.v6), research_mode scout: event-first discovery, a company-first roster lane, a stage-first lane for venture ICPs and an ATS hiring lane feed one resolve -> fit -> stage -> evidence -> paragraph path; free tools first, a provider-call ceiling per ICP, no requirements.txt (the runtime image's pydantic/httpx/idna only). Evidence rules mirror the judge: proof-source clauses, body datelines, affirmed stage sentences, homepage identity with blank company_linkedin, own-offering intent paragraphs. s26: a roster company whose free news feed is saturated and stops short of the ICP window gets one recency-filtered event search. s27: Teamtailor boards (the board's jobs.rss) and one free '<name> jobs teamtailor' search for a company whose pages link no ATS board, kept only when the tenant carries the company's name or domain label. s27 also: every short-feed roster company is event-searched (max 16) and a Public stage is proven first from the candidate's own release when its name leads into its '(EXCHANGE: TICKER)'. s28: Public stage evidence only from the company's own page or a wire copy; the release-based attribute quote exists behind attribute_from_release (off: the homepage passed 10 of 11 judged attributes, the release 1 of 2). s29 (09-27 official: 7 of 104 field companies qualified under the fail-closed capability review; ICPs carry two criteria): required_attribute points at the page sentence that names the company and states its offering (homepage, about/product pages, own release), a verified second criterion is added per draft (the paragraph keeps the primary), judge-bound Public ticker and PE quote gates, posting claims quote a body duty sentence, paragraph sentences are quote facts or one conditional clause. s29b: discovery sees the primary criterion only (a second-criterion event went out as the primary on 09-27), the candidate's event text must carry the primary category words, the resolve loop keeps 20 calls for finalists' evidence, and a company without a capability sentence ON ITS OWN DOMAIN is not submitted (an unproven required_attribute is a -10 false positive). s29c: funding age ranks Series C+ hiring drafts instead of vetoing them; stage proof gaps retain the ICP stage claim below proven drafts, with conflicts still vetoed. Capability recovery reads up to three extra own pages above the existing reserve and reuses the employer ATS posting; own-domain sentences need not repeat the name. Only an otherwise empty ICP keeps one capability-unproven draft. Full per-build history: the loop's STATUS.md. s31 = s29c + the s30 paragraph repair: the paragraph states EVERY emitted signal (s29's primary-only paragraph failed the judge's verified_signals_covered on 9 fit-passing company-draws, 8 of them Compass), and the local coverage proxy no longer counts the company's own name or the ICP offering phrase as signal content. s32 (09-28 analysis): per-ICP spend cap 0.72 is the ICP TOTAL across attempts (host sourcing_cost read at start and re-read near the cap; a settled read may lower the local estimate), research stops at 0.64 and the last 0.08 is held for the paragraph; writer coverage/recency checks; judge date parity; first-party funding announcements for the primary signal. v1: HIRING second criterion from the company's own ATS board (Greenhouse/Ashby/Lever/Workable APIs over free web egress, one cheap model pick).
